description: Returns the citation text, the statistics page URL, the license (CC BY 4.0 for the aggregate numbers), the source photo set (Face Research Lab London Set, with its DOI) and the JSON and CSV download URLs. Use this when quoting or republishing a number from get_reference_statistics or list_face_types; it holds no measurements itself, so use get_methodology instead for how the numbers were made. Takes no parameters; read-only.
name: get_citation
title: How to cite the data
